newsitem.title: USA: Roberts sees no reason for shr price drop.
newsitem.headline: Roberts sees no reason for shr price drop.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceuticals said on Wednesday it knew of no specific reason that accounted for the recent decline in its share price, and that its financial health was strong.
The company said it had over $100 million in cash and several new drug pipeline developments had strengthened its long-term prospects.

ProAmatine, the first of its pipeline drugs, began shipping and sales are expected to ramp up during 1997, the company said. Agrelin, another pipeline drug, was undergoing labeling review, which was usually the last step in the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval process, it said.
Roberts also said it had enriched pipeline potential by licensing compounds for development as possible breakthrough drugs for large, unsatisfied gastrointestinal markets.
By using a small portion of its cash, it said it planned to purchase a manufacturing facility, which was expected to eventually yield substantial cost of sales savings.
